name: Oath of Moment
text: Pick one enemy unit at the start of your Command phase; until your next Command phase, attacks by models with this ability against it may re-roll the hit roll, whatever that roll was.

name: Fury of the First
text: Attacks by this unit against the Oath target get +1 to hit.

name: Unstoppable Valour
text: This model's unit shrugs off a poor charge roll and rolls it again.

name: Veil of Time
text: This model glimpses moments before they happen; every weapon carried by the unit it leads strikes with [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
